title: Drain Fault
shortDescription: Washer cannot drain water within time limit.
fullDescription: Drain pump blocked, hose kinked, or pump failed. Cycle pauses with E1 displayed.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Open access panel and remove debris from drain pump filter.

fixSteps.title: Check hose
fixSteps.instruction: Straighten drain hose; verify <96 inches height.

title: Door Lock Fault
fullDescription: Door interlock not engaging or feedback signal missing.

fixSteps.title: Press door
fixSteps.instruction: Push door firmly until you hear click.

fixSteps.title: Replace lock
fixSteps.instruction: Remove front panel and swap door interlock.

title: Imbalance Detected
fullDescription: Sensor detected excessive drum vibration during spin.

title: Water Inlet Fault
shortDescription: Water not filling within time limit.
fullDescription: Inlet valve not opening or supply pressure too low.

fixSteps.title: Open valves
fixSteps.instruction: Verify hot/cold supply valves open fully.

fixSteps.title: Clean screens
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect hoses and rinse inlet screens.

title: Overfill Protection
fullDescription: Pressure sensor detects too much water; inlet valve may be stuck open.

title: Heating Fault
fullDescription: Heating element open or NTC sensor failure.

title: Motor Fault
fullDescription: Motor not turning or feedback missing. Belt may be broken.

fixSteps.title: Inspect belt
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear panel and check drive belt.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap motor or tacho coil if belt OK.

title: Pressure Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Air dome tube blocked or pressure switch failed.

fixSteps.title: Clean tube
fixSteps.instruction: Detach air dome tube and blow clean.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: UI board lost contact with main control.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Open top panel and reseat ribbon connector.

title: Suds Lock
fullDescription: Too much detergent or wrong type used.

fixSteps.title: Run rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Run rinse and spin without detergent.

fixSteps.title: Use HE
fixSteps.instruction: Switch to HE detergent and reduce dose.
